title: E-commerce Developer
summary: E-commerce developers build and maintain online stores on hosted or self-run commerce platforms, writing store themes, templates and add-ons. They sit in a brand's digital team or an agency, turning designs into store pages and connecting payments, stock and marketing tools.
dailyDuties: Build and customise store themes and templates
Add features to product, cart and checkout pages
Connect payment gateways and ERP or stock systems through APIs
Fix bugs reported by the merchandising team
Speed up slow pages on mobile
Review code and deploy store releases

skills.expectation: Build and customise storefronts on at least one commerce platform

Use Storefront or Admin GraphQL APIs
